blocks.text: AMD 公布了其 2026 年第三季度财报，目前预计 2027 年营收将增长超过 80%，高于分析师此前预测的 77%。

inlines.text: AMD 公布了其 2026 年第三季度财报，目前预计 2027 年营收将增长超过 80%，高于分析师此前预测的 77%。

blocks.text: 数据中心芯片是这一预测的主要驱动力，CEO 苏姿丰向分析师表示，该类芯片将占明年销售额的 80%。

inlines.text: 数据中心芯片是这一预测的主要驱动力，CEO 苏姿丰向分析师表示，该类芯片将占明年销售额的 80%。

blocks.text: 该业务板块已经支撑了第三季度业绩，受 Instinct GPU 和 EPYC 服务器处理器需求推动，营收跃升 97%，达到创纪录的 85.5 亿美元。

inlines.text: 该业务板块已经支撑了第三季度业绩，受 Instinct GPU 和 EPYC 服务器处理器需求推动，营收跃升 97%，达到创纪录的 85.5 亿美元。

blocks.text: 季度营收增长 45%，达到 133.8 亿美元，而 PC 和游戏主机芯片销售额下降 8%，至 37.2 亿美元。

inlines.text: 季度营收增长 45%，达到 133.8 亿美元，而 PC 和游戏主机芯片销售额下降 8%，至 37.2 亿美元。

blocks.text: AMD 预计第四季度营收约为 170 亿美元，上下浮动 3%，因 Helios 的产能正在爬坡——Helios 是一种将 MI455X 加速器与“Venice”CPU 配对的机架。

inlines.text: AMD 预计第四季度营收约为 170 亿美元，上下浮动 3%，因 Helios 的产能正在爬坡——Helios 是一种将 MI455X 加速器与“Venice”CPU 配对的机架。

blocks.text: Meta 正在测试首批 Helios 系统，这是 2 月达成的一项协议的一部分，该协议将在五年内购买最多 600 亿美元的 AMD AI 芯片。

inlines.text: Meta 正在测试首批 Helios 系统，这是 2 月达成的一项协议的一部分，该协议将在五年内购买最多 600 亿美元的 AMD AI 芯片。

blocks.text: 尽管调整后毛利率指引从 56% 下调至约 55%，股价在盘后仍上涨超过 8%。

inlines.text: 尽管调整后毛利率指引从 56% 下调至约 55%，股价在盘后仍上涨超过 8%。

blocks.text: AMD reported its 3Q-2026 earnings and it now expects revenue to grow more than 80% in 2027, ahead of the 77% analysts had modeled.

inlines.text: AMD reported its 3Q-2026 earnings and it now expects revenue to grow more than 80% in 2027, ahead of the 77% analysts had modeled.

blocks.text: Data-center chips drive that forecast, and CEO Lisa Su told analysts they’ll account for 80% of next year’s sales.

inlines.text: Data-center chips drive that forecast, and CEO Lisa Su told analysts they’ll account for 80% of next year’s sales.

blocks.text: That segment already carried the third quarter, with revenue jumping 97% to a record $8.55B on demand for Instinct GPUs and EPYC server processors.

inlines.text: That segment already carried the third quarter, with revenue jumping 97% to a record $8.55B on demand for Instinct GPUs and EPYC server processors.

blocks.text: Quarterly revenue rose 45% to $13.38B, while PC and console chip sales fell 8% to $3.72B.

inlines.text: Quarterly revenue rose 45% to $13.38B, while PC and console chip sales fell 8% to $3.72B.

blocks.text: AMD guided fourth-quarter revenue to about $17B, plus or minus 3%, as production scales for Helios, a rack pairing MI455X accelerators with “Venice” CPUs.

inlines.text: AMD guided fourth-quarter revenue to about $17B, plus or minus 3%, as production scales for Helios, a rack pairing MI455X accelerators with “Venice” CPUs.

blocks.text: Meta is testing the first Helios systems under a February deal to buy up to $60B of AMD AI chips over five years.

inlines.text: Meta is testing the first Helios systems under a February deal to buy up to $60B of AMD AI chips over five years.

blocks.text: Shares rose over 8% after hours, even as adjusted gross margin is guided down to about 55% from 56%.
